operatorDecision.question: How should P-264 obtain a road-name bucket that does not exist?
optionsOffered: add the road-name bucket at source in honest-decline-promote.ts (single implementation)
classify road-name inside the dry-run instrument only (zero blast radius, second implementation)
report road-class only and declare road-name UNMEASURED pending a planner ruling
operatorDecision.selected: add the road-name bucket at source in honest-decline-promote.ts

whatLanded.rootCause: depth-warm-city-batch.mjs flattened the six mechanical gates' reason strings into one list before classifying, destroying gate identity; classification could then only guess at prose.
defectsFixed: ROAD-NAME THEFT: the facesAnswer gate is the road-name parity gate, but its reason interpolates the resolved street name as a VALUE, so a parcel facing 'Front Street' injected the substring 'front' and the prose cascade claimed it as 'front-orientation'. A road-name failure was reported as an orientation failure.
NO ROAD-NAME CLASS: road-class had a bucket, road-name had none, so the split A-177 turns on was not readable off the artifact.
UNRECOGNISED FAILURES INFERRED RATHER THAN REACHED: the old catch-all was arrived at by elimination.

newApi.verifyFailGateBuckets: gates -> all failing classes by identity; returns EVERY failing class, not the first
newApi.ROAD_NAME_MISMATCH_BUCKET: new class, distinct from road-class and from orientation
newApi.UNCLASSIFIED_VERIFY_FAIL_BUCKET: explicit sink, reached not inferred; an unrecognised-but-failing gate lands here rather than being dropped

whatLanded.proseFallback: bucketVerifyFailReasons retained for string-only callers; road-name test reordered BEFORE the orientation test so the theft cannot recur. The bare 'front' test is deliberately kept because genuine orientation reasons are prose ('fresh labeling produced no front edge'); narrowing it would trade one misclassification for another.
whatLanded.batchRunner: classifies by gate; emits gateFailureBuckets (per-class counts) alongside the existing one-bucket-per-parcel failureBuckets.

evidence.wardenBlastRadius: ZERO. isHonestEnvelopeDecline (src/warden/envelope-sanity.ts:123) accepts any non-empty decline code, so a new bucket needs no whitelist change.
